error.bad_request: The request could not be read.
error.forbidden: You don't have access to this.
error.conflict: This was changed by someone else. Please reload and try again.
error.validation: Some of the information sent isn't valid.
error.rate_limited: Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.
error.internal: Something went wrong on our side. Your data is safe.
error.unavailable: This service is briefly unavailable. Please try again soon.
match.what_a_result_reveals: This compares your results and your partner's on our secure server. It tells you both only whether you share a finding in the same gene. Your other findings stay private. If you have just one finding yourself, a "yes" also tells your partner which gene you both have, since it can only be that one, and the same goes for you. The check can't rule out conditions the test didn't look for.
match.shared: You and your partner both have a finding in the same gene. This isn't a diagnosis, and a counsellor can go through what it means and what options exist. What you do next is your decision.
match.none_shared: No shared finding among the genes tested. This doesn't mean there's no risk: tests don't find every change, and some conditions aren't tested for.
match.cannot_determine: We can't give a result for this yet. This isn't a negative result. A counsellor can help work out what's needed.
access.report.ingest: A lab sent in a test report
access.results.preference: Your choice about seeing results changed
access.consent.service: You agreed to use the service
access.consent.grant: A share of your results was set up
access.consent.couple: You agreed to a couple check
access.consent.couple_withdraw: You withdrew from a couple check
access.shared.view: Someone you shared with viewed your results
access.person.link: Your account was linked to your lab results
access.couple.join: A partner joined your couple link
access.break_glass.open: Staff used emergency access to your care case
access.break_glass.review: Emergency access to your care case was reviewed
